newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Sun City may extend loss in '97, cut jobs.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Sun City may extend loss in '97, cut jobs.

text.p: South Africa's leisure and gambling complex Sun City, a subsidiary of Sun International, is expecting losses of more than 40 million rand in the 1997 financial year and could retrench 700 employees in a cost-cutting excercise, local Business Day newspaper said on Wednesday.

The paper reported Buddy Hawton, chairman of Sun International's parent company Kersaf Investments Ltd, as saying on Tuesday that Sun City had incurred losses of 39 million rand in the year to June 1996 and could exceed that amount this year.
"The level of losses is likely to remain significant for some time," Hawton was quoted as saying.
